text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 93 से 95 तक ‘One-Way Ticket-II’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 93 se 95 tak ‘One-Way Ticket-II’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘One-Way Ticket-II’ on pages 93 to 95 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What did the children like most when they reached the fair?

questionMeaning.hi: मेले पहुँचकर बच्चों को सबसे ज़्यादा क्या अच्छा लगा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Mele pahunchkar bachchon ko sabse zyaada kya achha laga?

steps.modelAnswer: When they reached the fair, the children liked the beautiful lights the most.

modelMeaning.hi: मेले पहुँचकर बच्चों को सुंदर रोशनी सबसे अच्छी लगी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mele pahunchkar bachchon ko sundar roshni sabse achhi lagi.

steps.question: Why did the children decide to stay together?

questionMeaning.hi: बच्चों ने साथ रहने का फ़ैसला क्यों किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachchon ne saath rehne ka faisla kyon kiya?

options: so that nobody got lost in the crowd
steps.answer: so that nobody got lost in the crowd
steps.modelAnswer: They decided to stay together so that nobody got lost in the crowd. It is difficult to trace anyone who gets lost.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्होंने साथ रहने का फ़ैसला किया ताकि कोई भीड़ में खो न जाए। खोए हुए को ढूँढना मुश्किल होता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhone saath rehne ka faisla kiya taaki koi bheed mein kho na jaaye. Khoye hue ko dhoondhna mushkil hota hai.

steps.question: Why do you think jalebies and bhajias are filling?

questionMeaning.hi: जलेबी और भजिया पेट भरने वाले क्यों हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jalebi aur bhajia pet bharne waale kyon hain?

options: They are fried and heavy, so they fill the stomach.
steps.answer: They are fried and heavy, so they fill the stomach.
steps.modelAnswer: Jalebies and bhajias are filling because they are fried and heavy food, so they fill the stomach quickly.

modelMeaning.hi: जलेबी और भजिया तले हुए भारी खाने हैं, इसलिए पेट जल्दी भर जाता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jalebi aur bhajia tale hue bhaari khaane hain, isliye pet jaldi bhar jaata hai.

steps.question: Why do you like a caterpillar-train ride?

questionMeaning.hi: तुम्हें इल्ली (caterpillar) जैसी ट्रेन की सवारी क्यों अच्छी लगती है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tumhe illi (caterpillar) jaisi train ki sawaari kyon achhi lagti hai?

options: It is a joy ride that takes us round the fair.
It is very slow and boring.
steps.answer: It is a joy ride that takes us round the fair.
steps.modelAnswer: I like the caterpillar-train ride because it is a joy ride and it takes us round the whole fair.

modelMeaning.hi: मुझे यह सवारी अच्छी लगती है क्योंकि यह मज़ेदार है और पूरे मेले का चक्कर लगवाती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Mujhe yeh sawaari achhi lagti hai kyonki yeh mazedaar hai aur poore mele ka chakkar lagwaati hai.

steps.question: What kind of seats does a merry-go-round have?

questionMeaning.hi: घोड़ों वाले झूले (merry-go-round) में कैसी सीटें होती हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ghodon waale jhoole (merry-go-round) mein kaisi seatein hoti hain?

steps.modelAnswer: A merry-go-round has decorated wooden horses as seats.

modelMeaning.hi: उसमें सजे हुए लकड़ी के घोड़े सीट होते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Usmein saje hue lakdi ke ghode seat hote hain.

steps.question: Why did Lambu want to go on a merry-go-round?

questionMeaning.hi: लंबू घोड़ों वाले झूले पर क्यों जाना चाहता था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Lambu ghodon waale jhoole par kyon jaana chahta tha?

options: because he could ride a horse there
steps.answer: because he could ride a horse there
steps.modelAnswer: Lambu wanted to go on the merry-go-round because he could ride a horse there.

modelMeaning.hi: लंबू उस झूले पर जाना चाहता था क्योंकि वहाँ घोड़े की सवारी कर सकते थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Lambu us jhoole par jaana chahta tha kyonki wahan ghode ki sawaari kar sakte the.

steps.question: Why is the story called ‘One-Way Ticket’?

questionMeaning.hi: कहानी का नाम ‘One-Way Ticket’ क्यों है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kahani ka naam ‘One-Way Ticket’ kyon hai?

options: They had money only for one way; Krishan's savings paid for the return.
The bus went only one way.
steps.answer: They had money only for one way; Krishan's savings paid for the return.
steps.modelAnswer: The story is called ‘One-Way Ticket’ because the children had money only for one way. Krishan's saved money paid for their tickets back home.

modelMeaning.hi: कहानी का नाम ‘वन-वे टिकट’ है क्योंकि बच्चों के पास सिर्फ़ एक तरफ़ के पैसे थे। कृष्ण के बचाए पैसों से वापसी के टिकट आए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kahani ka naam ‘One-Way Ticket’ hai kyonki bachchon ke paas sirf ek taraf ke paise the. Krishan ke bachaaye paison se waapsi ke ticket aaye.
